Container.Name: homechart
Container.Overview:
Homechart is a productivity application to manage your household data--budgets, tasks, recipes, calendars, inventory, and more. Homechart can run in your browser or on your Android and iOS devices via an app.
Requires a PostgreSQL 16 database to be set up. All data and application settings are stored in the database.
After creating your first account, configure additional settings (such as disabling public sign-ups, base URL, and SMTP email) directly in the Homechart WebUI under Admin > Config.
Documentation: https://homechart.app/docs/guides/get-homechart/self-hosted/#docker
